Chachamaru"Ha-haa! Queen's Army, yesterday's josh has gone where?"
Chachamaru"You seeing it too, bhai?"
Kageaki"Indeed. The Stable Corps seems to have disrupted them quite as effectively as their night bombing disrupted us."
Chachamaru"And we were prepared for it from the start. Them? Rude awakening. Actually, FIRE awakening. Good morning, saalo."
Chachamaru"Today's fight might favor us."
Kageaki"Yes."

en.html:
Today was December first.
Until December fourth, when Hikaru woke, Fudaraku Castle had to remain standing.

Three small steps for a calendar. For us, kindly drag an entire fortress through three more days of this chutiyapa without letting the walls, the soldiers or the plan fall down. The difference in military strength made it an extremely difficult requirement.

Still, if battlefield time would keep passing like this, perhaps the business might finish more easily than expected. The enemy's supplies, unlike its confidence, were not inexhaustible.

Fight until the fourth. Use up all the supplies immediately available to them. Leave Rokuhara inconveniently alive. Then the occupation army would have no option except its final weapon.

Exactly as Chachamaru and Wolf—as the Green Dragon Society—wanted. Their last resort, our required result. We were working very hard to make our own bombing necessary. A fine plan. From outside, one might have some questions.

ja.html:
今日は一二月一日。
　光が目覚める一二月四日まで、この普陀楽城を守り
通さなくてはならない。

　彼我の戦力差を考えればそれは至難だ。
　しかし、この調子で戦場の時間が過ぎてゆくなら、
案外と簡単に事は済んでしまうかもしれない。

　四日まで戦い、当座の物資をすべて使い尽くしても
なお六波羅を滅ぼせないなら、進駐軍は最後の武器に
頼る以外の選択を失うだろう。
　茶々丸、ウォルフ――緑龍会の望む通りに。
